subject: Future Tech
title: DNA: Life's Source Code
description: One-minute skill: DNA: Life's Source Code.

hook.text: Every living cell carries a set of instructions written in DNA.

buildup.text: Those letters are A, T, C, and G. They pair up and form a twisted ladder called the double helix.

discovery.text: Human DNA contains about 3.2 billion letter pairs packed into 23 pairs of chromosomes inside every cell nucleus.

twist.text: Humans share 99.9% of their DNA with each other. The 0.1% difference accounts for all our visible diversity.

climax.text: Understanding this code gave scientists the blueprint. Gene editing gave them the pen to rewrite it.

punchline.text: Life runs on a four-letter alphabet anyone can now edit.

quiz.question: How many base pairs are in the human genome?
